title: Polynomial-space membership from a ledger bound
statement: Let $L$ be a language of Boolean words, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $D,f\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every Boolean word $x$, there is a time $t$ at which $M$ halts with output consisting of the single Boolean indicator of whether $x\in L$, and uses at most $D(|x|+1)^f$ work-tape cells. Then $L$ belongs to polynomial space.
